intended_object: An auxiliary index map giving, for each numbered (Bourbaki-ordered) root generator of sp₂ₙ₊₂ in its standard matrix realization, the coordinate that receives the image of the source basis vector (from docstring and use in rootGeneratorWeight).
explanation: The function is index bookkeeping tied to the library's own Sum/Fin coordinate layout and generator numbering. It is used only to compute rootGeneratorWeight (target weight minus source weight) and then to show that these weights are the type-C Cartan matrix rows and simple roots. No standard mathematical notion corresponds to it. It does agree with positiveRootMatrix and negativeRootMatrix: raising generators target inl i; a lowering generator with i ≠ last targets inl (i+1); the long-root lowering generator `fromBlocks 0 0 (single last last 1) 0` sends e_{inl last} to e_{inr last}. So it matches its docstring, but it is an internal device rather than a mathematical object.
